resources.name: speaker-tokens
resources.notes: one test-account token per synthetic speaker; N tokens ⇒ an N-speaker meeting. Decrypt at run-time from the secret store; NEVER paste values here.

resources.name: stt
resources.validate: POST a ~1s WAV to /v1/audio/transcriptions with the token (the config.v1 audio probe / the wizard Test do exactly this) → require HTTP 200. NEVER grade by /balance: balance_minutes is 0.0 BOTH for an exhausted token (every request 402s) and for a billing-exempt service account (transcribes fine) — the 2026-07-19 recurrence was a green balance-style check over a token that 402'd every segment. /balance only NAMES the account.
resources.notes: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible STT service used by the bot.
